what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Myanmar, counted by IDMC and UNHCR side by side.
At the end of 2025, IDMC estimated 3639400 people living in internal displacement because of conflict and violence, and UNHCR counted 3628840.
Refugees from Myanmar live mainly in Bangladesh, Malaysia and Thailand.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Myanmar from 2021 to 2025, at war level from 2022, with the NUG, PSLF, CNF and PNLO among the government's opponents.
It also records armed conflicts over Karen, Kachin and Arakan territory, with the KNU, KIO and ULA among the groups fighting the government in recent years.
Earthquakes, floods, mass movements and storms are the disasters recorded for Myanmar in IDMC's data.

when.text: IDMC's figure rose from 470000 in 2009 to its highest, 3639400, at the end of 2025.
The largest changes came between 2021 and 2023, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2023 to 2025.

how.text: IDMC's new displacements count movements, not people: someone forced to move twice is counted twice.
The sources don't say where displaced people are living inside Myanmar.
